findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation: generic guidance on adding accessible names, roles, and states without specifying selectors or pages.
Priority 2 recommendation: generic advice to add alt text to images without referencing specific image elements or URLs.
Priority 3 recommendation: generic instruction to expose form labels without pointing to particular form fields or selectors.
Priority 4 recommendation: generic guidance on adding skip links or landmarks without identifying the affected navigation blocks or page URLs.
Priority 5 recommendation: generic advice to order headings correctly without citing specific heading levels or pages.
Priority 6 recommendation: generic instruction to replace bare divs with semantic elements without naming the problematic containers or page URLs.
Priority 7 recommendation: generic advice to profile slow routes and cache strategies without specifying affected pages or endpoints.
Priority 8 recommendation: generic instruction to add missing security headers site‑wide without referencing specific responses or URLs.
Priority 9 recommendation: generic advice to complete SEO metadata across the site without pointing to particular pages or elements.
Priority 10 recommendation: generic instruction to add missing Schema.org properties without naming the specific entities, selectors, or URLs.
Priority 11 recommendation: generic advice to enrich structured data with required and recommended properties without referencing particular entity instances or pages.
